title: ACS A1580 capture conditions
description: Everything a test condition can set. All groups and fields are optional.

frequency.description: A frequency with a unit (Hz, kHz or MHz), e.g. '2.5 MHz'.

time.description: A time with a unit (ns, us, ms or s), e.g. '10 us'.

voltage.description: A voltage with a unit (V), e.g. '20 V'.

gain.description: A gain with a unit (dB), e.g. '10 dB'.

slope.description: A gain slope with a unit (dB/us), e.g. '0.1 dB/us'.

rate.description: Sampling frequency; only 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50 and 100 MHz exist. SCPI: FREQ.

length.description: Samples per A-scan. Whether odd sizes are accepted is UNKNOWN. Allowed: 1024 to 36864. SCPI: DATA:LENG.

mode.description: master or slave operation. SCPI: MODE.

enabled.description: Pulser on or off. Emitted after every other header so the pulser stays in its old state while the rest changes. SCPI: TRAN:ENAB.

type.description: single: single crystal, burst on IN. dual: dual crystal, burst on OUT. SCPI: TRAN:TYPE.

reverse_polarity.description: true: the burst starts negative; false: positive. SCPI: TRAN:REV.

voltage.description: Burst amplitude. Above 50 V `check` prints a warning. Allowed: 5 V to 100 V, multiples of 5 V. SCPI: TRAN:PULS.

frequency.description: Burst frequency. Emitted in kHz, like the vendor example. Allowed: 10 kHz to 20 MHz. SCPI: TRAN:FREQ.

periods.description: Number of periods in the burst (the vendor code questions whether this is half-periods). Allowed: 0.5 to 16, multiples of 0.5. SCPI: TRAN:DUR.

gap.description: Gap between transmitter pulses (the vendor calls it a debug parameter). Allowed: 0 ns to 500 ns, multiples of 5 ns. SCPI: TRAN:GAP.

damping.description: Pulse damping on or off. SCPI: TRAN:DAMP.

damping_gap.description: Timing gap of the damping circuit. Allowed: 10 ns to 500 ns, multiples of 5 ns. SCPI: TRAN:DAMP:GAP.

impedance.description: Input impedance: 'high', '200' or '1000' (ohm). Quote the numbers. SCPI: TRAN:IMP.

gain.description: Constant gain; the base level of the TGC modes. Allowed: 0 dB to 80 dB. SCPI: GAIN.

preamp_combined.description: Combined preamplifier path, adds 20 dB. SCPI: GAIN:PRE:COMB.

preamp_split.description: Split preamplifier path, adds 20 dB. Whether both paths may be on at once is UNKNOWN. SCPI: GAIN:PRE:SPLIT.

high_pass.description: Analog high-pass cut-off. Emitted as the device index 0..3. SCPI: FILT:HPAS:IND.

mode.description: Constant gain (off), linear ramp, or arbitrary curve. SCPI: GAIN:TGC:MODE.

offset.description: Time before the gain starts to change.

slope.description: Gain change per time; may be negative or zero. The device stops at its own limits.

linear.description: Curve for mode linear. SCPI: GAIN:TGC:LIN.

time.description: Time of the point, e.g. 10 us.

gain.description: Gain added to the receiver gain at this time.

items.description: One point of an arbitrary TGC curve.

arbitrary.description: Curve for mode arbitrary: points of time and gain, times strictly increasing. The gains are added to receiver.gain. Maximum number of points is UNKNOWN. SCPI: GAIN:TGC:ARB.

mode.description: internal: periodic; ctp, encoder, ttl: external input. SCPI: TRIG:MODE.

interval.description: Time between acquisitions in internal mode. Emitted in us. Allowed: 100 us to 10 s. SCPI: TRIG:INT.

delay.description: Delay between the trigger and the acquisition. Emitted in ns. Allowed: 0 ns to 2.147483647 s. SCPI: TRIG:DEL.

count.description: Averaging count 0..8. Semantics UNKNOWN: it may be the number of acquisitions or an exponent (PROTOCOL.md CONFLICT 10); nothing here interprets it. Allowed: 0 to 8. SCPI: AVER:COUN.

constant_delay.description: 'auto' lets the device compute the constant delay (emits AUTO ON); a time emits AUTO OFF and then the value in ns. Allowed: 0 ns to 2.147483647 s. SCPI: AVER:DEL:CONS:AUTO, AVER:DEL:CONS.

random_delay.description: Upper bound of the random part of the pause between averaged acquisitions. Emitted in ns. Allowed: 0 ns to 32.767 us. SCPI: AVER:DEL:RAND.

extra.description: Raw SCPI header: argument, for settings this model does not cover, e.g. {'SENS:AVER:COUN': '3'}. Appended before TRAN:ENAB and never validated.
